evidence_kind: Pinned source inspection, not a separate engine-capability allocation experiment
observations: SamplingParams.flat_logprobs defaultsFalse. Product selectsTrue only for positive response-head requests; corrected candidate benchmark matches that contract.

Model max_logprobs is a request-validation cap. V2 sampling states store one int32 requested width per request; the request-set maximum drives compute_topk_scores. No head canvas is allocated from the positive cap in these paths. Both ordinary and head-capable modes use the same warmed engine for cycle comparisons.

A positive-width probe can make the sampler compute that maximum width over all rows of its mixed decode batch. Limiting exported evidence to one prompt group does not bound GPU top-K work to that group.
measurement_implication: The complete4096-token probe cycle measures mixed-batch amplification, capture, processing, transfers, old scoring, scalar summaries and normal metric emission. Do not estimate probe cost by multiplying full-SC cost by selected token coverage. No extra background probe collector or timer is introduced.
